jobs.description:
Our client, an international company operating in the manufacturing sector, is looking for a Customer Service Representative to join its customer-facing team.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will be responsible for managing customer orders from A to Z, ensuring an excellent customer experience, and acting as the key point of contact between customers and internal departments. You will work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Production teams to guarantee smooth order processing and timely deliveries.Key Responsibilities

• Manage customer orders throughout the entire order-to-cash process.
• Enter and follow up on orders in the ERP system.
• Serve as the primary contact for customer enquiries regarding orders, deliveries, and product availability.
• Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient order fulfillment.
• Monitor delivery schedules and proactively communicate any changes or delays.
• Resolve customer issues and identify appropriate solutions.
• Maintain accurate customer records and administrative documentation.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives related to customer service processes.
• Build and maintain strong long-term customer relationships.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Previous experience in Customer Service, Order Management, Sales Support, or a similar administrative position.
• Strong communication skills and customer-oriented mindset.
• Fluent in Dutch and English. French is considered an asset.
• Experience working with ERP systems (SAP knowledge is a plus).
• Good command of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Personal Skills

• Proactive and solution-oriented.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Team player with a collaborative mindset.
• Resilient and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Customer-focused with excellent relationship-building skills.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager - International Industrial Technology Group
jobs.description:

• Review purchase orders and contractual requirements
• Coordinate subcontractors, installers and internal stakeholders
• Plan resources, schedules and site activities
• Monitor budgets, milestones, risks and project profitability
• Negotiate scope changes and contractual deviations

• Minimum 7 years of project management experience in a technical or industrial environment
• Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously
• Strong understanding of industrial installations, equipment or infrastructure projects
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
• Comfortable handling contractual, financial and administrative follow-up
• Ability to read technical drawings and interact with engineering teams
• CAD knowledge is a strong asset
• Fluent French and Dutch with good English
• Solution-oriented, autonomous and assertive personality

Working for one of the top players in the logistics market. The company enterprising, competitive, and wants to grow as an organization. That is why they are looking for people who want to grow with them

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and growing a portfolio of clients across Brussels and Belgium.From first contact to long-term partnership, you'll own the entire sales cycle.You will:

• Identify and approach new clients

• Understand business challenges and propose the right consulting solution

We are a team of more than 74,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

Jobomschrijving

As part of the HR team, you will play a key role in supporting managers and employees on all operational and administrative HR matters. You will act as the first point of contact for Hard HR topics, ensuring compliance with local labour legislation, accuracy of HR data, and smooth execution of HR processes throughout the employee lifecycle.This position offers an excellent opportunity for an HR professional who wants to further develop expertise in Belgian labour law, HR administration, payroll coordination, and HR operations.Employee Lifecycle Management

• Manage and coordinate all administrative HR processes from onboarding to offboarding.
• Prepare employment contracts, contract amendments, and other employment-related documents.
• Follow up on employee movements, including promotions, transfers, changes in working time, and organizational changes.
Payroll & Compensation Administration

• Act as the main point of contact for payroll administration and collaborate closely with the payroll provider.
• Follow up on absences, leave requests, time registration, and benefits administration.
• Support compensation and benefits administration and related documentation.
Labor Law & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with Belgian labour legislation, collective labour agreements, and internal policies.
• Monitor legislative changes and support the implementation of required updates.
• Provide first-line guidance to managers and employees on contractual and administrative HR matters.
HR Operations & Data Management

• Maintain accurate employee data in HR systems (Workday and other HR tools).
• Ensure data quality, reporting accuracy, and compliance with GDPR requirements.
• Create and maintain HR procedures, policies, templates, and documentation.
Process Improvement

• Identify opportunities to improve HR processes and administrative efficiency.
• Support the digitalization and automation of HR activities.
Contribute to HR projects related to compliance, employee administration, and operational excellence.

• Master's degree, preferably in Human Resources, Business Administration, Payroll Administration or a related field
• Fluent in Dutch and French, both written and spoken; good command of English
• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in an HR generalist, HR operations or payroll-related role
• Good knowledge of local legislation (knowledge of Luxembourg legislation is a plus)
• Good knowledge of Office tools (Outlook, Excel, Power point)
• Knowledge of Workday is a plus
• Strong communication and presentation skills
• Strong analytical skills
• Comfortable working with digital HR systems, tools and process automation
• Results oriented
• Good administrative and organizational skills
• Open-minded, autonomous, flexible and proactive
• Able to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism

jobs.occupation: Veterinary Product Specialist - Pharma & Vaccines Poultry
jobs.description:
Our client is a global veterinary health company specialized in the research, development, production, and marketing of pharmaceutical products and vaccines for companion animals and livestock market. With a presence in 50 countries, our client is recognized as one of the top animal health companies worldwide. 

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Veterinary Product Specialist - Pharma & Vaccines Poultry - Benelux, you have the following responsibilities:Veterinary Service Manager: 

• Serve as the technical expert for animal health products (pharma & vaccines) for poultry 
• Provide scientific and technical support to veterinarians, farmers, and distributors across the Benelux region.
• Conduct training sessions, seminars, round tables and product demonstrations for veterinarians, farmers and distributors across the Benelux region.
• Develop your network of Key Opinion Leader (KOLs) within the poultry sector in the Benelux region. 
• Support the launch of new products by highlighting the technical & scientific benefits of the new products. 
Internal Collaboration:

• Work closely with the Sales teams to enhance customer engagement for Poultry products.
• Collaborate with the marketing team in the BENEDACH by providing technical & scientific advice on the creation of marketing support.
Market analysis & awareness: 

• Organize and participate to events and congresses to develop your network within the animal health industry and the expand the pharma, medicines and vaccines visibility within the Poultry sector.
• Represent the company at conferences, trade shows, and professional events.
• Monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging health challenges.
• Ensure compliance with industry regulations and company policies.

As a successful Veterinary Product Specialist - Pharma & Vaccines Poultry - Benelux, you have the following profile:

• Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) degree, Master Degree in Agriculture or equivalent.
• Experience / Knowledge in Poultry is mandatory. 
• You are autonomous with the willingness to travel in the Benelux region. 
• Ability to translate complex scientific information into practical guidance.
• Fluent in Dutch & English with a intermediate knowledge of French.

jobs.occupation: Lawyer (FR or NL)  - Employment Law - Brussels

• Advise Belgian and international clients on individual and collective employment law matters.

• Collective dismissals

• Cross-border employment issues
• Service agreements
• Employment litigation
• Social law implications of restructurings, insolvencies, and corporate transactions
• Support clients involved in mergers and acquisitions from an employment law perspective.
• Draft, review, and negotiate employment-related documentation.
• Work closely with senior lawyers, Counsel, and partners while progressively taking ownership of files.
• Provide pragmatic, business-oriented legal advice to clients across multiple sectors.

• Qualified Belgian lawyer.
• Minimum 4 years of experience in Employment/Labour Law, ideally gained in a recognized law firm.
• Strong command of Dutch, with professional fluency in French and English.
• Excellent drafting and analytical skills.
• Pragmatic, solution-driven, and client-focused mindset.

Our client is a major player in the logistics sector. They handle road transport, air freight, and sea freight.

The Antwerp branch is responsible for everything related to ocean freight. Around 100 employees work there and give their best every day to provide the highest possible level of service. They are seated in groups of four colleagues at work islands, spread over two floors. The atmosphere on the work floor is calm—sometimes hectic—but very pleasant. There is strong teamwork, and there is certainly room for regular laughter as well.

Every two weeks, a fruit basket is delivered to the departments. In addition, you can work with flexible hours, there are various opportunities for personal development, and subscriptions for the toll tunnel and the water bus are fully reimbursed.

In short: a very attractive employer!

Are you detail-oriented and passionate about data, pricing, and ocean freight? 

As a Rate Management Specialist, you’ll play a key role in ensuring accurate and efficient pricing processes that power our global operations.

You’ll manage customer contracts, tariffs, and costing data across our systems, enabling seamless auto-rating and auto-costing and supporting our journey toward full digitalization.

Working closely with commercial, operational, and system teams, you will help deliver tailored pricing solutions that meet customer requirements while supporting ongoing digitalization and process improvement initiatives. This position is essential in maintaining data integrity and optimizing the performance of our global rating platforms.

• Strong attention to detail and analytical mindset
• Experience in Ocean Freight pricing or operations (minimum 2 years)
• Strong communication and collaboration skills
• Proficiency in Microsoft 365
• Fluent English and Dutch
